extraction.Name: Edward Livermont, Junior
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not wish his patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment, when it was issued, April 13, 1918, but the Indian Agency told him that it would be assessed for the taxes, and later sold for same, if he did not accept the patent, and pay his taxes, so he accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to a man by the name of Becker, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1200.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: Becker, of Gordon, Nebraska, for $1200.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: his idea in selling the place was to get out of paying taxes, which he found hard to do
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms his wife's land for a living, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; has good health; has a wife to support, and his wife has very poor health; has helps to support a brother, who is a cripple; kept taxes paid up until 1922 when he sold; did not sell for debts incurred prior to receipt of patent in fee; was not in debt at the time he sold; considers he received a poor price for his allotment; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; affidavit sworn December 26, 1928
